AND a.DELETED = ? AND (a.IS_IAM = ? or a.IS_IAM is null) AND ( a.CONTRACT_NAME like ?hai%?%hong? ) AND ( a.CREATOR_ACCOUNT_AUTH = ? or a.EXECUTOR_ACCOUNT = ? or ?=? or a.ID in ( SELECT info.ID FROM LAS_CONTRACT_INFO info INNER JOIN ( SELECT list.BEAN_ID FROM HD_WF_COMPLETED ids INNER JOIN HD_WF_INST entry ON ids.INSTID = entry.ID INNER JOIN HD_WF_LIST list ON entry.ID = list.ID WHERE ? = ? AND list.FORM_ID = ? AND ids.ACCOUNT = ? ) wf ON info.id = wf.bean_id ) ) ) a
